summary: Frontend-only gesture QA of ReviewSwipeCard via the dev harness at /gesture-harness.html. All 10 mobile-touch scenarios and all 6 desktop-mouse scenarios PASS. The slow-drag regression fix (onDrag clears the long-press timer) is confirmed working: a >1s slow drag right produces ONLY rate:3 and NO 'edit' in h-log. Touch input driven via CDP Input.dispatchTouchEvent + Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled at 390x844.

verified_flows_mobile_touch_390x844.tap_to_flip: PASS — after touch tap, h-flipped=true, h-log='flip'.
verified_flows_mobile_touch_390x844.swipe_right_rate3_Good_خوب: PASS — hint 'خوب' visible during drag; h-index 0->1, h-log tail 'flip,rate:3', card returns unflipped.
verified_flows_mobile_touch_390x844.long_press_800ms_edit_no_flip: PASS — h-log appends 'edit', h-flipped unchanged (false), h-index unchanged.
verified_flows_mobile_touch_390x844.slow_drag_right_>1s_regression: PASS — 25 touch-move steps over ~1.25s to +120px produced ONLY 'rate:3' new events after the pre-flip; NO 'edit' fired. Confirms the onDrag clearPress fix.
verified_flows_mobile_touch_390x844.short_drag_<60px_spring_back: PASS — 40px drag produced no new h-log events, index unchanged, card stayed flipped and sprung back.
verified_flows_mobile_touch_390x844.gestures_off_swipe_ignored: PASS — after clicking h-off, a right swipe produced zero new events (h-log unchanged, h-index unchanged, card still flipped).
verified_flows_mobile_touch_390x844.gestures_on_reenables: PASS — after h-on, right swipe again produced 'rate:3' and index incremented.

verified_flows_desktop_mouse_1920x800.long_press_edit: PASS — appends 'edit' after ~850ms hold, no flip.
verified_flows_desktop_mouse_1920x800.slow_mouse_drag_right_>1s: PASS — only 'rate:3' logged, no 'edit'. Regression fix holds on desktop as well.

critical_code_review_comments: ReviewSwipeCard.handleClick: single tap already invokes onFlip immediately. The doubleTapFlip flag only suppresses the SECOND tap of a rapid double-tap. If product intent is 'ONLY a real double-tap flips (single tap does nothing)', current implementation does not match. From this harness the requested behaviour ('double-tap/tap flips the card') is satisfied because single tap flips too — flag for product confirmation only, not a bug for this iteration.
canSwipe = g.enabled && flipped means swipe only works after the card is revealed. This is by design and confirmed by the tests, but worth documenting in the UI hint text.
hint element is unmounted on touchEnd (setHint(null)) so it is only visible mid-drag; captured 'خوب' successfully during the right swipe. No issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (10/10 mobile touch scenarios + 6/6 desktop mouse scenarios)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Harness route: https://code-review-396.preview.emergentagent.com/gesture-harness.html. It mounts the real ReviewSwipeCard from src/components/review/ReviewSwipeCard.tsx. Use CDP Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled + Input.dispatchTouchEvent for mobile touch. detectSwipe threshold is 90px, so 120px displacement is a reliable swipe. Long-press timer is 550ms in code (task said ~800ms; hold >=600ms to be safe). Card must be flipped before drag (canSwipe = g.enabled && flipped). h-off/h-on write to real gesture settings via setGestureSettings + REVIEW_SETTINGS_EVENT, which the card listens to.
rca_of_issue: No bug found in this iteration. The prior fix (clearPress() call inside onDrag in ReviewSwipeCard.tsx line 64) is verified: a slow drag that would previously have hit the 550ms long-press threshold no longer fires onEdit, because as soon as motion begins the pending press timer is cleared. Regression test scenario: pointer-down at t=0, small moves starting immediately, total duration ~1.25s, ends past 90px threshold => detectSwipe returns 'right' => onRate(3) fires, onEdit never fires. Verified on both touch (mobile) and mouse (desktop).
